note: Both sets struggle significantly with reading the graphs and hallucinate non-existent entities (like FFA-W3-1, FFA-W3-2, FFA-W3-210). Set A incorrectly claims the lift coefficient is 0.0 at an angle of attack of 0 degrees for multiple airfoils, whereas the graph clearly shows it is around 0.5. Set B manages to extract a few correct graph readings, such as the maximum lift-over-drag ratio for SNL-FFA-W3-500 being around 20, making it slightly better despite many errors.
